ruin.thelostcamera.solstice_shrine.name: The Solstice Shrine
ruin.thelostcamera.solstice_shrine.hint: Standing stones and a broken altar have been reported across plains, meadows and open woodland.
ruin.thelostcamera.solstice_shrine.biome: Plains, meadows, open forests and birch forests.
ruin.thelostcamera.solstice_shrine.descr: The oldest known gathering place of the Orma. Its central altar tracked the seasons, announced sowing time and brought neighbouring households together.
ruin.thelostcamera.solstice_shrine.echo: Both braziers were lit at dawn on the solstice. The altar markings may be the earliest Orma calendar.
ruin.thelostcamera.orma_homestead.name: The Orma Homestead
ruin.thelostcamera.orma_homestead.hint: Remains of fences, small dwellings and outdoor hearths may survive across temperate countryside.
ruin.thelostcamera.orma_homestead.biomes: Plains, meadows, temperate forests and birch forests.
ruin.thelostcamera.orma_homestead.descri: A self-sufficient family holding with a home, a small training hut, a drying rack and an outdoor oven. It preserves the daily life of the first settled Orma.
ruin.thelostcamera.orma_homestead.echo: The equipped training figure suggests that every household was expected to defend its stores and the roads linking nearby communities.
ruin.thelostcamera.frontier_watchtower.h: A square stone tower once watched over passes, taigas and windswept heights.
ruin.thelostcamera.frontier_watchtower.b: Taigas, old conifer forests, windswept hills and stony peaks.
ruin.thelostcamera.frontier_watchtower.d: A compact watch post raised generations after the earliest Orma homesteads. Its beacon carried warnings from one valley to the next.
ruin.thelostcamera.frontier_watchtower.e: A carved stone beside the ladder repeats the shrine’s solar mark, showing that later builders still reused the symbols of the ancient Orma.
